limitations: The profile is explicitly provisional. 12 of 18 actual LibreOffice probes differ. No automatic tolerance or result substitution turns those differences into passes.
Office and WPS target-version tests have not run. LibreOffice is an independent observer, not the target compatibility authority.
Gray coefficients are an explicit provisional policy. The 2016 preset table short goldenrod alias differs from its long alias and is reported.
Working-space state survives consecutive HSL and referenced-color transformations. Target-application behavior for these chains still differs in some probes.
Only source theme color schemes are queried; object fill/line/text/effect properties and their automatic style placeholder context are not yet compiled.
Original exact percentage lexical values remain unchanged. The numerical working format is f64; values outside its finite range are explicitly unresolved.
Colors are not a renderer, font shaper, layout engine, player or complete Document/SourceBinding import.
Existing source text editing limitations, incomplete advanced objects and unresolved earlier LibreOffice geometry resave differences remain.
MCP/SDK/Skill/Plugin, production Worker/OperationService and Musterwork integration are incomplete; E0-E3 remain open.
